description:
BrainMorph as the LUMIR organisers run it: 512 keypoints, the H model, thin-plate splines without regularisation; a keypoint network trained on 100,000 brain MR images. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline brainmorph. Brain MR, aligned pairs. The authors' repository at the commit of the LUMIR call (later commits dropped the H model), with its dependencies at versions of that date (torch 2.3 on Python 3.11) in an environment uv builds on first use (5 GB), and the weights checked against their hash. A GPU is recommended, up to the Ada generation: torch 2.3 has no kernels for Blackwell GPUs, so there the app runs on the CPU (no --gpu). Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).

How to cite:
A. Q. Wang et al., BrainMorph: A foundational keypoint model for robust and flexible brain MRI registration, MELBA 2025.
